summary: RFLO and rate e-prop (which are mathematically identical for a vanilla rate RNN with linear readout) reached only 55.3% per-symbol accuracy on the copy task after 3000 training steps, compared to BPTT's 100% accuracy achieved by step 200 -- a gap of 44.7 percentage points. The 90% accuracy threshold was never crossed by the local learning rules, confirming that the credit-assignment limitation of biologically-plausible online learning rules imposes a substantial performance cost on this working-memory task, despite comparable computational speed (~0.85s vs 0.82s per 100 steps on A100).
